title: queue_cmd list --json --session <sid>: the reply
description: One JSON object on stdout, exit 0. See queue-contract.md. Unknown keys are ignored. queue check validates a reply against the type, const, enum, pattern, maxLength, minimum, items, anyOf, required and properties keywords of this file.

lane.description: lane:<name> or auto:<name> (letters, digits and . _ / -), or null

open.description: a count, or a list of question ids (each at most 64 characters: letters, digits and . _ : / -)

pending.description: a count (a whole number, 0 or more)

held_by.description: the session id of another live session that holds the lane, or null

label.description: one line of at most 80 characters

commands.description: a list of list, adopt, adopt:must-exist and add

lanes.description: lane ids, or {id, holder, open, preview} objects
